other_conditions: Minimum land area of 2 acres (higher thresholds apply for certain machines)
Must be registered on the DBT portal
Women beneficiaries limited to 30% of allocations
Selection is on a first‑come, first‑served basis
benefits_summary: Provides up to 75% subsidy on planting materials and up to 50% subsidy (subject to caps) on various horticultural machines for eligible farmers.
